title: EasyVideoR1: Easier RL for Video Understanding
unit: Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; JD.COM

workflow.rollout_unit: problem-level video/image QA prompt with n sampled responses
workflow.trainer_input: DataProto batch containing prompt-response sequences, reward tensors, old/ref logprobs, and advantages
workflow.algorithm: GRPO by default in examples; inherited hooks for other RL algorithms
workflow.architecture: colocated Actor/Rollout/Reference on one GPU pool with phased vLLM and FSDP execution
workflow.not_streaming_rl: does not define per-second actions, silence, delayed streaming events, policy-version freshness, or streaming-context sample sealing
